record.t: Was first elected to the West Virginia House of Delegates (2014).
record.q: Hornbuckle, 37, first was elected to the House in 2014, and works as a financial advisor with Edward Jones in Huntington.

record.t: Was selected by the Democratic caucus as House minority leader.
record.q: The Democratic members of the West Virginia House of Delegates took a historic caucus vote Tuesday, Aug. 8 to select Delegate Sean Hornbuckle, D-Cabell, as their next minority leader.

record.t: Previously held the position of Minority Leader Pro Tempore.
record.q: Delegate Kayla Young, D-Kanawha, was selected to serve as Minority Leader Pro Tempore, the position Hornbuckle had previously held.

record.t: Held up multiple poster boards depicting incidents of historical racial violence.
